attributes.name: ARIA accessibility attributes
attributes.definition: Whether the page markup includes ARIA attributes (roles, labels, states) to support assistive technology.

values.definition: ARIA attributes are included in the markup.
ARIA use is partial or unclear.

attributes.name: Navigation toggle accessibility
attributes.definition: Whether the mobile/hamburger navigation toggle is built as an accessible control (button element with ARIA state).

values.definition: Hamburger/menu toggle is a button with ARIA attributes for expanded/controls state.
Toggle lacks button semantics or ARIA state.
The page has no collapsible navigation toggle.
